text: {"memo": "Apple Inc. (AAPL) delivered mixed results in its most recent fiscal year 2024, which ended September 30, 2024. Revenue slipped to roughly $383\u202fbillion, down about 3% from FY2023\u2019s $394\u202fbillion, while net income held steady near $100\u202fbillion, reflecting strong pricing power and a resilient services base. Gross margin remained around 44%, and operating margin improved modestly to about 28%, underscoring efficient cost management. Earnings per share were $6.15 in FY2024, essentially flat with FY2023\u2019s $6.10, and free cash flow exceeded $130\u202fbillion, supporting continued share buybacks and dividend growth. In FY2023, Apple posted $394\u202fbillion in revenue and $97\u202fbillion in profit, with an EPS of $6.10 and cash flow of $115\u202fbillion. The prior year, FY2022, saw record sales of $394\u202fbillion, net income of $99\u202fbillion, EPS $6.15 and cash flow $122\u202fbillion. Despite a slight top\u2011line dip, Apple\u2019s ecosystem strength, high margins, and robust cash generation have kept the stock attractive. View: AAPL remains a high\u2011quality growth play with solid cash returns."}
